void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Primary page background, hero canvas — near-black with a blue-violet undertone, not a true neutral

obsidian-surface.$description: Obsidian Surface — Elevated panels, nav bar, secondary cards — one step up from canvas, reads as a subtle surface tier

slate-layer.$description: Slate Layer — Card backgrounds, input fields, inset panels — the main surface level for content containers

carbon-border.$description: Carbon Border — Hairline borders, dividers, card edges — barely visible structural lines on dark surfaces

ash-text.$description: Ash Text — Muted helper text, disabled labels, tertiary metadata

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Secondary body text, inactive icons, subdued UI labels

mist-text.$description: Mist Text — Link resting state, sub-labels, low-emphasis body

lunar-white.$description: Lunar White — Primary body and heading text — a cool off-white, the dominant readable surface in the system

frost-white.$description: Frost White — High-contrast text, hover states, icon highlights — the brightest text in the hierarchy

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ultraviolet-key.$description: Ultraviolet Key — Brand accent — links, highlight icons, gradient termini, the signature violet that signals encryption

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Brand gradient anchor — hero gradient origin, logo violet, saturated primary brand tone

amethyst-glow.$description: Amethyst Glow — Mid-gradient violet, hover states on brand elements, secondary accent fills

shadow-iris.$description: Shadow Iris — Tinted shadows and border accents — gives depth a violet cast rather than pure black

plum-depth.$description: Plum Depth — Deep accent backgrounds, violet-tinted shadow layers, card hover glows

code-rose.$description: Code Rose — Code syntax highlighting (Monokai-style keywords), inline emphasis in code blocks

roobert.$description: Headlines and display text — the brand's signature face. Aggressive negative tracking at large sizes makes characters pull into each other, creating a custom-display feel no system font replicates. Use for h1–h3, hero copy, and section titles.

inter.$description: Body text, navigation, buttons, UI labels, footer copy. The workhorse face for everything below the headline tier. Weight 580 is an uncommon mid-weight that fills the gap between 500 and 600 for UI emphasis.

roboto-mono.$description: Code snippets, terminal output, technical labels. The 0.400em tracking at small sizes is a deliberate eyebrow/label pattern for uppercase micro-copy like 'Built for Developers'.
